statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail falls from 17 to 10 because the down leg that drove the last three hours has been fully retraced. NQ trades 29,536.75 against a 29,538.75 settle, some 203 points above the 29,333.25 session low, after recovering the entire move within about an hour of the 13:30 UTC cash open. VIX at 15.98 is well below its 16.56 session high, and the 10-year at 4.800% is lower on the day and off its 4.818% high. Stress stays extreme at 81 because Brent at $101.51 and WTI at $96.37 are both at new session highs and rate-hike pricing for the 16 September FOMC has firmed, but that is a difficult environment rather than a failed-retracement path.
recommendation: Tail at 10 maps to EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD and sits well below the block threshold. The 13:30-15:00 UTC window published an hour ago has resolved benignly, so the danger window moves to a narrower 17:00-18:00 UTC, where the US 10-year note auction and the Apple product keynote coincide with a 10-year yield near 4.80%; the conditional forecast lifts tail to 15 for that hour and holds 14 in the hour after it. The next scheduled cluster is August PPI, Core PPI and initial jobless claims at 12:30 UTC on 10 September, which carries the highest conditional tail in the window at 18. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by the mapped state.
headline: NQ recovers the full 203-point down leg to 29,536.75, flat on the settle, as VIX fades to 15.98 and the 10-year eases to 4.800%; tail drops from 17 to 10 while oil sets new highs
body:
The tail argument of the past three hours rested on a sequence of lower lows into and through the cash open, with NQ pinned near a 29,333.25 low. That premise is now gone. NQ trades at 29,536.75 against a 29,538.75 previous settle, essentially unchanged on the day, having covered the whole 203-point distance back from the low within roughly an hour of the 13:30 UTC open. Investing.com shows the same round trip at 29,559.75, marginally positive, on an identical 29,333.00 low and a 29,633.75 high. A complete retracement of the session's directional leg is the clearest available evidence against the pathological no-retracement path, so tail steps down from 17 to 10.

The cash index tells the same story with a smaller amplitude. The NASDAQ-100 sits at 29,463.88, down 0.15% against a 29,507.70 previous close, inside a 29,393.26 to 29,563.60 range. The cross-asset picture has loosened rather than hardened. VIX at 15.98 is up 1.65% on the day but is a full 0.58 point below its 16.56 session high and has faded from the 16.18 reading an hour ago. The 10-year at 4.800% is now lower on the day against a 4.806% previous close, near the bottom of its 4.794 to 4.818 range, so the rates channel is not pressing at this moment.

Energy is the one input that has genuinely extended. Brent trades at $101.51, up 3.67%, and WTI at $96.37, up 3.59%, both above the $100.66 and $95.71 levels seen earlier in the session. Reuters reports Brent through $100 for the first time since 24 July as attacks on tankers and Saudi energy facilities disrupt regional flows, with volumes through the Strait of Hormuz down to under 2 million barrels a day from 8 to 9 million weeks earlier. Yahoo Finance reports that traders now price roughly a 60% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike at the 16 September FOMC. That combination keeps stress extreme at 81, one point above the previous reading, because an energy-led inflation impulse into a Fed that may be tightening is a demanding environment for any strategy.

The calibration distinction matters here: a demanding environment is a stress condition, while tail measures whether mean reversion is denied for long enough to overwhelm a reverse or grid approach. Equities are absorbing a 3.7% crude move and a firmer hike probability with a full round trip and a flat close-to-current print, which is the opposite of denied mean reversion. Confidence rises to 89 on live corroborated futures, cash-index, volatility, yield and commodity levels from independent primary sources.

The danger window narrows to 17:00-18:00 UTC. The US 10-year note auction and the Apple product keynote fall in the same hour with the 10-year near 4.80%, and a weak auction is the one credible mechanism for a delayed yield-led second leg today. Conditional tail is 15 there and 14 in the hour after. The overnight path carries 8 to 9 with no scheduled US catalyst, and the highest conditional reading in the window is 18 at 12:00 UTC on 10 September for August PPI, Core PPI and initial jobless claims. No forecast hour reaches the watch band.
lookbackSummary: Across the 24 clock-hours from 14:00 UTC on 8 September to 13:00 UTC on 9 September the mapped state was EA_ON in every published hour except 12:00 UTC on 9 September, which was WATCH. Tail ran between 5 and 20. It sat between 5 and 9 for nineteen of the twenty-three published hours, printed 15 twice, at 14:00 UTC on 8 September in the first full US cash hour and at 11:00 UTC on 9 September when the overnight band broke, reached its peak of 20 at 12:00 UTC as the session low extended to 29,333.25, and eased to 17 at 13:00 UTC as the first retracement appeared. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 9 September, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. The dominant trend in the window is stress, which climbed almost without interruption from 69 at 17:00 UTC on 8 September to 83 at 12:00 UTC on 9 September as crude advanced through $99 and then above $100 and the 10-year reached its highest level in nearly three years, before settling at 80. Dominant mode was mixed in nineteen hours, normal in one and trend-down in three, the trend-down readings clustering in the two hours of the overnight break and in the first US cash hour of 8 September. Confidence held in a narrow 85 to 89 band throughout.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one high-impact US release cluster: August PPI, Core PPI and initial jobless claims at 12:30 UTC on 10 September, which falls inside the second-to-last forecast slot. August CPI on 11 September and the 16 September FOMC decision sit outside the window. Conditional tail runs in an 8 to 18 band and never reaches the watch band, so every one of the 24 slots maps to EA_ON. The path peaks at 18 for the PPI and claims hour and at 15 inside the published 17:00-18:00 UTC danger window, where the US 10-year note auction and the Apple product keynote coincide with a 10-year yield near 4.80% and a weak auction is the one credible route to a delayed yield-led second leg. The overnight stretch from 21:00 UTC to 05:00 UTC carries 8 to 9 with no scheduled US catalyst, where the residual risk is a Middle East supply headline gapping the thin Globex book rather than a developing trend. Conditional stress declines gradually from 81 to about 74 overnight and rebuilds to 84 into the PPI release, on the assumption that the energy backdrop persists. Confidence decays from 89 to 75 across the window, which reflects the shrinking value of current price-path evidence rather than any expected deterioration in conditions.
